summary: Enhance your investment decisions with our Behavioral Finance and Investor Psychology Training. Gain valuable insights to improve your financial strategies.
lede: Behavioral finance and investor psychology examine how bias, emotion and social influence shape financial decisions. For professionals who make, advise on or review financial decisions, the training applies these ideas to investment reviews, client risk profiles and decisions during volatile markets. Learners practise identifying anchoring, overconfidence and herd behavior, interpreting risk tolerance, setting pre-commitment rules, keeping decision journals and communicating risk clearly.
audienceIntro: This behavioral finance and investor psychology training is designed for professionals who make, advise on, review, or communicate financial decisions and need better control over bias, emotion, and risk interpretation.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include basic financial literacy, familiarity with investment products or portfolio concepts, and experience interpreting risk, return, or client suitability information. No programming is required, and advanced behavioral modeling is covered at an introductory operational level rather than a statistical engineering level. Participants should come prepared to discuss at least one real decision challenge from investing, advisory, treasury, or financial planning work.
